snippet.title: ||Trailer|| Fallen Princess
snippet.description:
Original video by Ambition, posted here for archive purposes.






*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*
The epic tale of a once-noble Princess who falls ever deeper into darkness!
Follow Princess Aki and her friends as they adventure across the continent of Malorum in search of riches, treasures, bounties and more to bring the people of her kingdom back out of the poverty that she sunk them into!
Form parties, fight battles, craft equipment, level up, evolve characters, summon allies and much, much more in this turn-based adventure RPG!
Choose to play the epic Story Mode with hundreds of quests and help the young Princess make new friends and face her foes, or take the fight online in Arena Mode with real-time PVP battles against players all around the world!
